objective: Scoped tasks: every new task names the exact files it may change and the specs that must pass; CI fails a PR that changes files outside its tasks; the test runner can run a task's specs alone.
acceptance_criteria: task.schema.json has files and tests; validate-tasks requires both for every task not in studio/legacy-unscoped.txt, and checks in-review specs exist and are registered
tools/check-scope.mjs fails a PR with no task file change or with a file outside the changed tasks' files (tests in place-check.test.mjs)
ci.yml runs the scope check on pull requests
lune run tests/run <Name> runs only matching specs and marks the result partial in test-results.json
studio/TASKS.md explains how to write a scoped task
verification: CI green including the scope check on this PR; node --test tools/place-check/place-check.test.mjs
